entities.summary: Galyani Vadhana, Princess of Naradhiwas was a princess of Thailand and the elder sister of King Ananda Mahidol and King Bhumibol Adulyadej. She was also a direct granddaughter of King Chulalongkorn and Queen Sri Savarindira and the aunt of King Vajiralongkorn.
